mistake_reason: At step 6, WebSurfer confidently asserted the existence of a direct "A Song of Ice and Fire" link in the See also section of the July 3, 2023 revision of The Lord of the Rings, citing a fabricated revision ID and location. This claim was not grounded in any verified page content or tool-based evidence and contradicted the actual link structure as of that date. The hallucinated direct link led the team to conclude the path required only 1 click, which is incorrect; the true minimum is 2. This matches FM-4.1: Hallucination—factually incorrect information without grounding in tools or data.
